lines.en: My camouflage hangs on me.
Each step of mine is heavy.

lines.zh: 我压过灌木，叶子落了一地。
lines.en: I crush through bushes, scattering leaves.
I am tall.
My claws leave prints in the soil.
I cross the forest slowly.
I turn sideways around a tree.

lines.zh: 草叶从我背上簌簌落下。
lines.en: Leaves rustle off my back as I move.
My tail sweeps the grass.

lines.zh: 我伏低，听你踩断哪根枝。
lines.en: I crouch and listen for which twig you snap.
I walk low.
There are twigs in my camouflage.
I stand like a bush.
My camouflage keeps shifting.
I watch the path ahead.

lines.zh: 裹在伪装里，我连气都放轻。
lines.en: Wrapped in camouflage, I barely breathe.
I stand as a clump of bushes.
I wait for prey to pass.
I lower my head into the leaves.
My claws pin the fallen leaves.
I count the nearby sounds.
I push the leaves aside and look up.
Vines are wound round my tail.
I stay in the forest.
I pull my camouflage lower.
You can't tell I'm here.
I am in that thicket beside you.
Your gaze passed right over me.
I moved slightly.
My camouflage looks like a bush.
Do you hear the leaves?
I count the twigs you snap.
You've come up against the trunk.

lines.zh: 我抖开身上的叶子才站起来。
lines.en: I shake off the leaves before rising.
Now you see me.
Leaves and grass drape my body.
You took half a step closer.
I haven't moved. The disguise holds.
Your hand is at your waist.

lines.zh: 我的伪装里探出一只黄眼。
lines.en: One yellow eye shows through my ghillie.
A patch of my camouflage fell off.

lines.zh: 腐叶底下滚出一声低吼。
lines.en: A growl rolls out from under the leaves.

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了你的手。
lines.en: I remember that blow to your hand.
I press my weight back onto my soles.
I can still move through the woods.
I retreat into the bushes.

lines.zh: 叶子底下，我的眼睛没动。
lines.en: Under the leaves, my eyes don't move.
I shrink my head into my shoulders.
I draw my claws back.
What you hold is too small.

lines.zh: 我闻到叶子底下的味道。
lines.en: I smell it under the leaves.
That won't fill me.
Set it on the tree root.
I edge out of the thicket slowly.
Back away from the leaves.
That's not a mouthful for me.
Shake and I miss my lunge.
What you hold is too small.
I must come close to eat it.
You ran into my camouflage.
I sink back into the leaves.
My body is harder than a bush.
My shoulder shoves you aside.
Don't press against my camouflage.

lines.zh: 我带着一身的枝条转身。
lines.en: I turn, dragging twigs with me.

lines.zh: 我们撞得枝叶落了一地。
lines.en: We collide and leaves fall everywhere.

lines.zh: 你踩在我藏在叶下的爪上。
lines.en: You stepped on my claw under the leaves.
I shift aside to clear the game trail.
Steady — don't rattle the woods.
I move through the forest alone.

lines.zh: 林子里只有我一丛会走的灌木。
lines.en: I am the only walking thicket here.
I turn my face, and the leaves follow.

lines.zh: 这片林子的兽径只留我一人。
lines.en: These forest trails are mine alone.

lines.zh: 我的伪装不适合两个人。
lines.en: My camouflage isn't for two.
Back off my game trail.
I retreat into the bushes.
I have more woods to patrol.
This forest is good.
I settle into a heap of grass.

lines.zh: 我低头，从叶子里叼起来。
lines.en: I dip my head and take it from the leaves.

lines.zh: 这个能塞进我的伪装里。
lines.en: This fits under my camouflage.
I tuck it into my camouflage.

lines.zh: 这点东西填不了林子的肚子。
lines.en: Not enough for a forest appetite.
This is worse than leaves.
I press it into the leaf litter.
I sniff the soil on it.
I look over whatever falls.

lines.zh: 那东西没叶子味，我丢开。
lines.en: It smells of nothing leafy, so I toss it.
My woods don't lack this.
Then we do this another way.
My camouflage falls away.
You've backed behind the tree.
That tree won't stop my shoulder.
At three I come out of the bushes.
Now — the leaves move.

lines.zh: 腐叶底下，我的爪子抓紧了。
lines.en: Under the leaf litter, my claws grip.
I heard the twig you snapped.
I shake my camouflage off.

lines.zh: 我的伪装和灌木一起挪动。
lines.en: My ghillie moves along with the bushes.
Each step brings me closer.
I shift through the bushes.
Do you hear the leaves rustling?
I close in one more thicket.
I shift along a thicket.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，叶子响一次。
lines.en: Each step makes the leaves rustle.
I follow low.
You shouldn't have left the path.

lines.zh: 我数着你换了几次方向。
lines.en: I count your changes of direction.
I go around behind the tree.
Two steps closer and you're mine.

lines.zh: 伪装散开，我的爪子先到。
lines.en: The ghillie bursts apart and my claws arrive first.
I ram you with my body.
That claw throws the leaf litter up.
I clamp your shoulder; ribs creak.
You're pinned against the tree.
One more shove and you give half a pace.
You've fallen back into the bushes.
I press no further.

lines.zh: 我这一身伪装，是草编的。
lines.en: This camouflage of mine is woven grass.

lines.zh: 我的爪尖划到你的手臂。
lines.en: My claw tips rake your arm.
That came down on your shoulder.
This forest is deep.
My camouflage is still new.
I flex my claws.
I smell the wind.
I step out of the thicket one pace at a time.
I begin patrolling the woods.
I crouch lower than the bushes.
I wait for the prey to take two steps.

lines.zh: 我伏下来，只露一双眼睛。
lines.en: I flatten, showing only my eyes.
I rise from under the leaves.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的伪装，我跳开。
lines.en: Fire catches my camouflage and I spring away.
I fell down the slope and rolled.
Water floods in; I struggle up.
The blast strips my camouflage.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎穿了叶子，进了我的肩。
lines.en: An arrow through the leaves, into my shoulder.

lines.zh: 紫色的光让我的伪装失效。
lines.en: Violet light breaks my camouflage.
No prey in these woods for days.
The flash exposed me.

lines.zh: 脚下没有土，我一层层往下落。
lines.en: No earth underfoot; I fall in layers.
